label: D-Link DGS-1520-28
description: D-Link DGS-1520-28 (A1) - 28-port Layer 3 stackable smart managed switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, 2x 10GBASE-T RJ-45 and 2x 10G SFP+ uplinks or stacking ports, 128 Gbps switching capacity, 95.24 Mpps, RJ-45 console, 1U, no PoE.

fabric.note: Vendor switching capacity of 128 Gbps with a 95.24 Mpps maximum forwarding rate, from the A1 datasheet specification table. 128 Gbps is exactly the full-duplex aggregate of the port census: 24 gigabit ports x 2 Gbps plus four ten-gigabit ports x 20 Gbps (48 + 80). 95.24 Mpps matches 24 x 1.488 Mpps plus 4 x 14.88 Mpps, so the two vendor figures agree with each other and with the port count.

notes: Ports, per the D-Link DGS-1520 Series A1 datasheet: 24 x 10/100/1000Base-T, 2 x 10GBase-T, 2 x 10G SFP+. That is 28 front-panel ports, and the four ten-gigabit ports double as stacking ports. No PoE on this model - the PoE standard and PoE budget rows read N/A. Power 100-240 VAC, maximum consumption 30.4 W, standby 20.9 W at 100 V / 21.5 W at 240 V, heat 103.7 BTU/hr, 51.8 dB(A), MTBF 468,252 hours, 441 x 207.4 x 44 mm, 2.33 kg. The chassis takes the DPS-520 redundant power supply, which the datasheet restricts to non-PoE models. The datasheet publishes the census and the media but not a front-panel port index, so the ports are named by media (ge / xgt / sfp+) rather than by a number this document does not state. Vendor software, same document: physical stacking of up to 8 units over 10GBase-T and/or SFP+ at up to 80 Gbps in ring or chain, virtual stacking (Single IP Management) of up to 32 units, 16,384 MAC entries (512 static), jumbo frames to 12,288 bytes, 32 LACP groups of 8 ports, 802.1D/802.1w/802.1s STP with BPDU filtering, root guard and loop guard, ERPS v1/v2, RSPAN, 4K VLAN groups (VID 1-4094) including selective Q-in-Q and VLAN translation, IGMP v1/v2/v3 snooping, MLD v1/v2 snooping, and L3 routing - static routes, RIP/RIPng, OSPF, VRRP v2/v3, PIM-SM/DM/SSM, 1024 hardware routing entries and 4096 L3 forwarding entries shared by IPv4/IPv6, 16 IP interfaces. Management: web GUI over IPv4/IPv6 with HTTPS, CLI, Telnet, SSH/SFTP, SNMP v1/v2c/v3, sFlow, RMON, LLDP/LLDP-MED, dual images and dual configuration files, ZTP and DHCP auto-configuration. Green: EEE, per-port power saving, time-based PoE (PoE models). Hardware Rev A1, 19-inch 1U, 100-240 VAC, operating range -5 to 50 C, EMI Class A.
